## Objective

Deliver coherent bounded read data, confined sources, read-only sessions and explicit assets.

## Scope

- Materialize coherent immutable reader snapshots
- Adapt deterministic discovery with stable continuation
- Project exact entries and typed neighborhoods
- Implement precise registered source inspection
- Build read-only HTTP operations and bounded errors
- Enforce bootstrap and project-isolated sessions
- Package explicit offline production assets
- Add explicit reader launch and bounded health inspection

## Entry conditions

- Phase 1 complete; selected contracts and runtime/build authority available.

## Exit criteria

- Snapshot/data/service/session/assets and explicit launch/health contracts pass focused tests; minimal production build can support later UI consumers without authoring or optional backend prerequisites.

## Risks

- Current loader materialization needs snapshot bracketing; old write dispatcher must not be reused.

## TASK-004 - Materialize coherent immutable reader snapshots

Implement a thin immutable snapshot adapter over load_project, complete pre/post selected-input digests and non-creating read-only observation of existing publication coordination; reject active or unresolved selected-input transactions, bound retries/cache lifetime and retire views after active readers finish.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-026, REQ-033 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/ontology_explorer_snapshot.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_explorer_snapshot.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-003 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Stable partial canonical commits are not current coherent snapshots; digest equality alone is insufficient.
- Never introduce another coordination store or change writer/publication behavior to make reading convenient.

### Acceptance criteria

- Mixed-version inputs yield snapshot_changed/knowledge_updating; entry/relations/graph/cursor output never silently mixes snapshots.
- Cache keys include selected root/project, snapshot, helper/adapter and presentation versions; cache memory/concurrency/lifetime are bounded.
- Stale evidence does not erase safe canonical definitions and no read creates publication locks, repairs hashes or builds products.
- Interrupted multi-file publication with stable bytes is rejected until existing owner state establishes completion or recovery; malformed or unreadable relevant coordination returns a safe bounded diagnostic.
- Read-only coordination brackets materialization and covers missing-to-present lock races; ordinary browsing creates no lock, intent, receipt, repaired source hash or generated output.

### Planned verification

- Inject concurrent selected-file replacement and publication-boundary changes; prove complete view or specific bounded failure with route-refresh semantics.
- Test stale source bytes, unchanged-mtime content changes, helper/mapping change and retired snapshot lifecycle; compare protected hashes/timestamps.
- Use deterministic barriers with actual publication/recovery helpers on disposable fixtures for active writes, interrupted partial commits with stable digests, missing-lock creation races, relevant versus unrelated transactions and continuous churn. Assert a complete version or specific bounded refusal, never a mixed version.

## TASK-005 - Adapt deterministic discovery with stable continuation

Project compact search/browse summaries using canonical ranking with semantic=False, exact visibility/type mappings before pagination and signed query-bound keyset continuation.

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Exact IDs, labels, aliases and lexical definitions retain deterministic order/reasons; duplicates remain distinct and aliases retain preferred identity.
- Category/lifecycle filters apply before paging; one snapshot has no duplicate/skipped IDs and byte-limited empty output is explicitly incomplete.
- Changing query, filters, direction, sort, project/root, snapshot, service instance or reading session invalidates a cursor; endpoint bounds never widen agent contracts.

### Planned verification

- Run fixture cases for AT-02, AT-03, AT-04, AT-05, AT-06, malformed/tampered/expired cursors, exact stable IDs, empty lexical query browsing and unsupported category IDs.
- Patch optional semantic/RDF/inference entry points to fail on invocation and verify normal discovery succeeds.
- Replay a valid cursor across two concurrent sessions, service restart, expired session and second selected project; only the exact live cursor scope may continue.

- A source request cannot browse arbitrary paths or another record/project; recorded/current hashes and freshness are distinct.

### Acceptance criteria

- Invalid Host/Origin/CSRF/session and other-service credentials disclose no project data; server fixes root and rejects browser authority/scope fields.

- Expiry uses fresh reader sessions and preserves safe desired context; browser never claims it restarts Python.

## TASK-010 - Package explicit offline production assets

Add explicit static build/manifest serving and neutral reader configuration; document production build/launch error behavior and restrict HTTP to the approved bundle manifest. Stage builds privately and publish complete manifest-owned explorer/assets output; this task establishes a minimal build/service fixture, and TASK-021 rebuilds and qualifies the complete later UI.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Installed production assets include build identity, dependency lock and notices in the package; HTTP serves only runtime assets with correct MIME/no-store/nosniff/referrer/CSP protections.
- Missing bundle returns incomplete-package error with a maintenance route; no browser launch performs npm/build/install or enables advanced profiles.
- Strict explorer configuration is optional-safe-default or explicit validated selected-project configuration; no depot IDs/labels become shared frontend constants.
- Manifest, hashed runtime files and notices are included by the unchanged Template discovery rules; dist/build exclusions stay effective. The manifest names runtime assets only, while the lock and build instructions remain package metadata outside HTTP access.

### Planned verification

- Verify manifest rejects unknown/encoded traversal/symlink assets and excludes repository trees, node_modules, caches, unnecessary maps and package-manager files from HTTP.
- Run controlled offline production smoke with external network disabled after an explicitly authorized build; observe CSP failures rather than weakening policy.
- Inspect the exact updater-discovered package list and manifest hashes; no requirement depends on excluded dist/build output or a live Node dev server.

### Risks

- Existing advanced-health reports workbench identity and may require a separate legacy assessment path during transition.

### Acceptance criteria

- The proposed explore --open command starts only the selected reader service and optionally opens a fresh safe bootstrap entry under explicit launch authority.
- Health distinguishes installed/configured/running/readable/stale/wrong-project/unavailable without unrelated optional readiness sweeps or startup side effects.
- Service identity differs from sys4ai-ontology-workbench; health uses a bounded explicit loopback origin and never accepts a bootstrap URL.
- Old authoring CLI behavior is classified and preserved until qualified cutover; no documentation claims the reader can restart a stopped process from a web page.

### Planned verification

- Run launch/stop/health with optional advanced configuration and runtimes absent, invalid assets/configuration and wrong project origin.
- Assert health is bounded and does not provision, read proposal inventory or expose root/source/session details to unauthenticated requests.
- Compare help/schema/docs spelling with the exact implemented commands.
